business_scope.primary_industry_name: Off-Price Wholesale Liquidation of Branded Overstock Apparel

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, effective 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (creates the Financial Information and Analysis Unit - UIAF); Law 1121 of 2006 (counterterrorism financing); Law 1762 of 2015 (anti-smuggling and money-laundering offenses); Law 2195 of 2022 (anti-corruption); Superintendencia de Sociedades Resolution 164 of 2022, as supplemented by Resolution 165 of 2022 (mandatory UBO 'beneficiario final' report through SIRE); Decree 1074 of 2015 (business and commercial registry regime).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or equivalent constitutive instrument of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry or Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Legal Existence of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry or competent government chamber

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized General or Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) appointing the Colombian legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport of each UBO and appointed legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / notary public of the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and significant counterparties against the Colombian UIAF laundered-money and terrorism financing lists (Lista de Riesgos / Listas de Personas Excluidas), OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated sanctions list, and local judicial/administrative exclusion registries. Enhanced due diligence is triggered by any politically exposed person (PEP) status, adverse media, or nexus to high-risk jurisdictions; negative screening results must be documented before name clearance is requested.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) operated by the Cámara de Comercio of the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish is the official language of registry filings; corporate names must be expressed in Latin-script characters and transliterated into Spanish or English where the trade name originates from a non-Latin alphabet. The legal name must be distinguishable and not identical or confusingly similar (homonimia) to any existing registered enterprise.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Seguros / Compañía de Seguros (requires Superintendencia Financiera authorization)
Fondo de Pensiones / Fondo de Inversión (requires financial-sector license)
Bolsa de Valores / Mercado Público de Valores (requires prior financial regulatory approval)
Cooperativa (reserved for cooperative legal entities under solidarity-economy law)
Nacional / Presidencia / Ministerio / Superintendencia (misleading official or sovereign connotation prohibited)
Salud / Hospital / Clínica (requires Superintendencia de Salud authorization)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same Chamber of Commerce within ten (10) business days of notification, incorporating the registry officer's observations, or submit a new homologation request through RUES with amended alternative names. No statutory fee is refunded upon rejection. If rejection is based on a reserved or prohibited token, prior written authorization from the competent ministry or superintendency must be attached to the re-filing; the renewed name certificate is subject to a fresh 30-day validity window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address may be accepted for registration purposes provided a physical domestic address is declared as the registered domicile for service of process and tax notifications. Purely virtual structures without any operational footprint are tolerated at incorporation but give rise to heightened commercial-substance and permanent-establishment scrutiny before DIAN and the Superintendencia de Sociedades; for off-price apparel liquidation trading, a physical mark or warehouse address materially strengthens the substance profile.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 15–25% probability of an unannounced inspection within the first fiscal year for a low-risk wholesale trader; the likelihood increases above 40% if the registered office is exclusively virtual, the entity files zero or irregular VAT returns, or DIAN flags discrepancies between declared operations and banking flows.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the intended registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff set by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the S.A.S. private incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff (base fee plus proportional rate on subscribed capital)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register filing through the SIRE system under Resolutions 164 and 165 of 2022
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Mandatory electronic filing, no state tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille of foreign certificate of incorporation (per document)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs or competent authority in the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille fixed tariff of the issuing jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille of notarized power of attorney (per document)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs or competent authority in the country of execution
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille fixed tariff of the issuing jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of apostilled foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 20–40 per page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, UIAF and local exclusion-list screening configuration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/CFT data provider or external compliance counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a single low-risk entity screening pack

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation corporate and UBO due-diligence legal counsel fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a low-risk single-entity S.A.S. incorporation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, Arts. 1-50); Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971, Book II, Arts. 98-120 and 372-374); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (Régimen Único del Comercio); Circular Única de la Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the company's registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), operating through the national Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) and the Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation deed with full bylaws), elevated to Escritura Pública before a Notary only if real property is contributed as paid-in capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Authorized capital must be fully subscribed at incorporation; the paid portion may be distributed in installments with a maximum deferral of two years (Ley 1258 de 2008, Art. 4). No escrow bank account is legally mandated; banking onboarding requires source-of-funds verification under anti-money-laundering rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: This First Board Resolution of [COMPANY] S.A.S., a Colombian Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, is unanimously adopted by its founding shareholders. RESOLVED: 1. The subscription of the entire authorized share capital is ratified and the shares are allotted to the subscribers named in the incorporation instrument. 2. The registered office is established at [street address], [city], Colombia, and the statutory email [address] is designated for official notices. 3. [Name] is appointed Legal Representative and President, and [Name] is appointed Secretary, with full powers under Law 1258 of 2008, the bylaws and the Commercial Code. 4. The Legal Representative is authorized to complete Chamber of Commerce registration, obtain the NIT, open bank accounts, and perform all ancillary acts to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RUES online portal of the competent Cámara de Comercio (www.rueco.com)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names in the RUES/VUE system. The portal issues a free non-exclusive availability certificate valid for approximately 30 days. Verify absence of confusingly similar registered trademarks or company names before proceeding.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate names (up to three alternatives)
Identification data of each founding shareholder (passport or national ID)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is rejected due to similarity, reserve an alternative name immediately; a formal objection may be filed with the registration office of the Cámara de Comercio for review within the statutory term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Incorporation Deed and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders (or sole shareholder) with optional notarization; notary mandatory only for real-property contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, incorporating the bylaws: corporate name ending in S.A.S., domicile, corporate purpose (wholesale off-price liquidation of branded overstock apparel, ISIC 4641), term, authorized/subscribed/paid capital, board structure, legal representative powers, conflict-of-interest rules, and dispute-resolution mechanism. Have every founder sign and initial each page.
required_dossiers: Copy of valid identification of each shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any contradictory or illegal clauses by private amendment document executed unanimously before filing; defective provisions can be cured by a subsequent full or partial reform of the incorporation deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Chamber of Commerce Registration (Matrícula Mercantil y Registro de la Sociedad)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's domicile via VUE/RUES (electronic filing) or in-person
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed incorporation deed through the VUE, pay the registration and merchant-registry fees (approximate USD 35 for nominal capital), and await the registration officer's legal review. The S.A.S. acquires full legal personality as of the date of this registration; the Chamber stamps an official certificate of existence and legal representation.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation deed (scanned with secure signatures)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a requerimiento (missing-document notice), supply the required evidence within 10 business days; if registration is refused, exhaust the recursos de reposición y apelación before the same registry authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax ID Issuance (NIT and RUT with DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial, Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Chamber registration, obtain the provisional NIT automatically transmitted to DIAN. The legal representative must complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) electronically through DIAN's portal, confirming the economic activity code (4641 ISIC / CIU 4641), declaring tax responsibilities (income tax, VAT, ICA complement), and downloading the authenticated RUT.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or requires adjustment of the RUT, correct the affected data fields (e.g., jurisdiction, activity code, responsibilities) and resubmit electronically; a prior RUT can be amended without losing the NIT.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Books Registration and Final Existence Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (registration of corporate books and issuance of official certificates)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the mandatory corporate books (share register, minutes of shareholder meetings, minutes of board of directors, accounting records), have each book's opening sheet submitted to the Cámara de Comercio for stamping (physical or electronic), and request the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which evidences the company's legal standing and officer powers for banks and counterparties.
required_dossiers: Corporate books with numbered and foliated pages
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the book stamping is delayed or rejected, correct formatting/foliation deficiencies and refile; a written explanation from the Chamber is available for banking purposes while the process is pending.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda (Registro de Industria y Comercio - ICA), Curaduría Urbana or Secretaría de Planeación (land use and occupancy certificates), and Cuerpo de Bomberos (fire safety)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific ministerial operating license is required for wholesale off-price apparel trading (requires_statutory_license: false), but the company must obtain (i) Registro de Industria y Comercio (ICA), (ii) Certificado de Uso del Suelo and Ley de Funcionamiento for warehouse/commercial use of the premises, and (iii) relevant municipal commercial permits before stocking and selling.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Agencia Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the municipal environmental authority (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente or Empresa de Aseo)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - wholesale finished-garment warehousing is not listed in Annex II of Decreto 1076 de 2015; no formal EIA study or environmental license is required. The facility must nonetheless register municipal water/sewage use and solid-waste collection contracts.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater discharge to municipal sewers must comply with Resolución 0631 de 2015 (pH 6.0-9.0; BOD5 90 mg/L; TSS 90 mg/L; grease and oils 15 mg/L); air quality for any combustion equipment complies with Resolución 2254 de 2017; solid waste, including post-consumer garments and packaging, must be sorted under Resolución 2184 de 2019 and handled through authorized municipal collection routes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety inspection and certificate from the municipal Cuerpo de Bomberos; structural and occupancy verification per NSR-10 seismic building regulations; Certificado de Uso del Suelo from the Curaduría Urbana confirming light-commercial warehouse use; mandatory workplace health and safety program (SG-SST) with risk classification registered with an Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL) in accordance with Resolución 0312 de 2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — official portal www.dian.gov.co; taxpayer service portal MUISCA (muisca.dian.gov.co).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor establishing a Colombia S.A.S. must execute incorporation via a public deed or private document filed with the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio); the S.A.S. then must register with DIAN to obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and inscribe the RUT (Registro Único Tributario). The legal representative (extegratorily appointed by shareholders) must personally file the RUT application, declaring the company's address, business activities, and tax regime. Foreign shareholders are not required to have a local TIN for the company formation, but the S.A.S. as a domestic juridical person receives a unique NIT automatically upon DIAN approval; foreign direct investment must be registered with Banco de la República if financing is deposited in local currency.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (a S.A.S. is a capital company subject to Colombian corporate income tax at a 35% rate for 2024-2025; resident companies are taxed on worldwide income with specific source attribution rules, while branches and non-resident-owned entities without a permanent establishment are subject to more limited territorial sourcing).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is available to foreign entities for a Colombian S.A.S. The S.A.S. is irrevocably taxed as an entity under Colombian corporate income tax. Taxpayers meeting size and turnover limitations may opt into the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (SIMPLE) for a blended tax payment replacing CIT, VAT, and municipal industry and commerce tax, but off-price wholesale apparel traders of substantial scale are generally ineligible. Group companies can voluntarily prepare consolidated tax returns only when authorized by DIAN under strict common-control and substance requirements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Colombian national VAT (IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas), a registration-based consumption tax administered by DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic threshold is required for VAT registration; any natural or juridical person habitually engaged in the sale of goods, provision of services, or import of tangible goods must register in the RUT and obtain a specific VAT registration and/or e-invoicing authorization irrespective of turnover. For small merchants below COP 8 billion annual gross income, access to the SIMPLE regime may be available, but a standard S.A.S. apparel liquidation trader should maintain a full VAT registration as a sales taxpayer (responsable de IVA) once involved in taxable transactions.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Since 2019, all VAT-responsible taxpayers in Colombia must issue electronic invoices (Factura Electrónica) through DIAN-approved technology providers; the invoicing system uses a 'CUDE' (Código Único de Documento Equivalente) or 'CUFE' (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) digital stamp and requires pre-validation by DIAN through the Muisca web portal or machine-to-machine API. Invoices must be transmitted in real time and may be subject to DIAN rejection before legal issuance; large taxpayers must also file daily export-related electronic declarations through the VUPE or foreign trade single window. Digital stamping is mandatory, with no general postponement for wholesale garment exporters; the unique transaction code is embedded in the invoice XML and validates the fiscal status to the recipient.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Colombia to foreign markets qualify for a 0% VAT rate. The sale must meet the definition of an export under Decree 1165/2019 and the Customs Statute: goods must physically leave Colombian territory permanently, be documented in a duly submitted and confirmed export customs declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX), and the exporter must receive and collect the export proceeds through the Colombian foreign exchange market within the statutory period. For services rendered to non-residents for use abroad, a separate 0% regime applies. The off-price wholesale apparel trader must prove that the invoice corresponds to actual goods, the end-user is a foreign purchaser, and cargo has been dispatched to a foreign destination; if the goods are sold to a foreign purchaser but are ultimately consumed in Colombia, the zero-rating is denied.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX/Declaración de Exportación) approved by DIAN customs in the VUCE/VUPE system
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of goods from Colombian territory
Inward Foreign Exchange Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro) or documentary evidence of wire transfer showing payment of the export price from the purchaser to the exporter
Commercial invoice of export sale, marked with the export VAT exemption statement
Export packing list and certificate of origin (if applicable for FTA preference)
Mandatory annual export reconciliation report to the Grupo de Cumplimiento of DIAN
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to rigorous ex-post audit by DIAN. The exporter must make the goods available for physical inspection and provide customs, banking, and currency exchange records; any inconsistency in the B/L, payment instrument, or declared quantity automatically generates a cross-screening mismatch. If DIAN rules that no genuine export occurred or a refund involved fraudulent documentation, the responsible party will be required to pay the over-credited VAT (calculated retroactively at the 19% rate), a penalty of up to 200% of the tax surcharge for fraudulent refund abuse, plus default interest. Criminal liability is triggered under Article 402 of the Colombian Criminal Code for fraudulent export refunds or smuggling; on conviction, the exporter faces imprisonment of 48 to 108 months and confiscation of the goods or assets. Additionally, false customs declarations are sanctioned under Law 1762/2015 with fines measured on the customs value of the goods and temporary or definitive suspension of the exporter's registration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia as the supervisor of authorized foreign exchange intermediaries and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) as the customs-linked exchange control enforcement body
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso is a floating currency, and Colombia maintains a largely liberalized capital-account regime. However, all transactions classified as exchange market operations under the Colombian foreign exchange code must be channeled through authorized intermediaries under the mandatory canalización obligatoria regime. Profit remittances are permissible for registered foreign direct investment without prior administrative approval, but the entity must ensure full tax compliance and file the required exchange declarations through the authorized bank. Conversion into COP is generally frictionless for licensed commercial operations, provided the underlying transaction and supporting documents are valid.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods exporters must collect export proceeds and channel them into the Colombian foreign exchange market through an authorized intermediary within six months of the export declaration date, unless Banco de la República grants a timely extension. The full amount of the export proceeds is subject to the reintegro obligation, meaning the funds must be sold to the market or placed in a permitted foreign-currency account if authorized. There is no partial conversion ratio, and the exporter cannot retain the foreign currency indefinitely outside the authorized market without falling under the statutory penalty regime.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low legal viability for core treasury operations. Offshore digital EMIs and fintech payment providers that are not authorized by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia cannot act as foreign exchange intermediaries, cannot register export proceeds, and cannot file Colombian exchange declarations. Such platforms may be used only for ancillary payments and are not acceptable substitutes for the mandatory canalización obligation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian AML/KYC practice generally requires at least one legal representative, a corporate director, or the duly appointed attorney-in-fact to appear physically before a Colombian bank officer and a notary for signature attestation and activation of transactional accounts. Remote opening by non-resident shareholders alone is not standard; the entity must appoint a resident legal representative who can satisfy the physical-interview requirement. Some banks allow a hybrid process with apostilled powers of attorney and video authentication, but this is subject to the bank's risk appetite and is not assumed for a trading entity with large cross-border flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly registered S.A.S. with 100% foreign ownership and no local operating history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificado de Cámara de Comercio, registered bylaws, Registro Único Tributario (RUT), initial tax statements, audited financial statements of the foreign parent, bank references, completed Formulario de Beneficiario Final, corporate resolution authorizing account opening, and a transactional forecast.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Off-price liquidation of branded overstock apparel raising trademark, counterfeit, and black-market concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original purchase or surplus liquidation agreements with authorized brand owners or authorized liquidators, letters of assignment, vendor invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, customs import declarations, internal quality-control records, and product authenticity certification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disproportionately large outbound supplier payments relative to the entity's paid-in capital or declared turnover
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month business plan, working capital projection, pro-forma supplier contracts, evidence of supplier due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation for the capital injection, and the foreign investment registration certificate issued through the Banco de la República.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner or counterparty located in a high-risk or sanctioned jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid passport, tax residence certificate, completed beneficial-owner declaration, criminal record certificate, independent background-check report, PEP screening outcome, and notarized declarations explaining the lawful origin of funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions from non-resident shareholders must arrive by SWIFT transfer to the Colombian S.A.S. account at an authorized commercial bank. The bank will classify the incoming funds under the foreign-exchange declaration purpose code for foreign direct investment and file the corresponding cambial declaration with Banco de la República through the approved electronic system. Required supports include the share subscription agreement, updated Cámara de Comercio certificate, corporate resolution approving the capital increase or initial contribution, proof of source of funds, and the FDI registration certificate or registration application.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border disbursements for inventory purchases and trade settlements must be executed through SWIFT MT103 via the authorized Colombian bank. Each payment must be matched to a valid commercial invoice and, where applicable, to the DIAN import declaration and foreign-exchange import form. For domestic supplier settlements, the ACH Direct rail may be used for COP-denominated payments. For high-value transactions or riskier suppliers, a commercial documentary letter of credit (L/C) issued through the bank's international trade desk provides secure settlement and a clearly auditable chain of evidence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable COP/USD forward contracts through authorized intermediaries
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) for COP exposure where delivery is impractical or unnecessary
Cross-currency swaps between COP and USD or EUR for cash-flow matching
Deliverable FX options supported by a real underlying commercial transaction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of mercantile registration (renovación de la matrícula mercantil) and filing of approved financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Chamber of Commerce of Bogotá or the chamber of commerce of the SAS's registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March following the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a statutory surcharge and default interest; prolonged non-renewal may result in cancellation or suspension of the mercantile registration, preventing the SAS from lawfully carrying out commercial activities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Formulario 210 / declaración de renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March-April of the following tax year according to the NIT last-digit DIAN schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty for late filing under Article 641 of the Colombian Tax Code: 5% of the tax due per month or fraction, capped at 100%, plus default interest; continued non-filing may trigger assessment proceedings and criminal tax sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and documentation of annual shareholders' meeting (asamblea anual de accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the fiscal year-end, normally by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the annual shareholders' meeting may be invoked by shareholders and justifies void claims; the related financial statements cannot be validly filed with the registry until approved.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual update of ultimate beneficial owners (RUB declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN - Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: During the annual RUB filing window defined by DIAN and published in the tax compliance calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update UBO information is punishable as a tax filing infraction; fines may be imposed per day of delay, and inaccurate filings may be sanctioned under DIAN Resolution 000164 of 2022.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: The SAS must appoint a 'revisor fiscal' when gross assets or gross revenues exceed the equivalent of 30,000 UVT at year-end, when the by-laws require one, or when the company is otherwise subject to statutory audit by law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia (NIIF) under Law 1314 of 2009; SME entities prepare financial statements under NIIF para PYMES (Group 2), and micro entities may apply the Group 3 simplified accounting standard.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under DIAN Resolution 000164 of 2022, the SAS must declare its ultimate beneficial owners and confirm any shareholding changes during the annual RUB window. Share transfers must also be recorded in the share transfer register before the renewal application; the updated register and shareholders' meeting minutes supporting the transfer must be available for inspection and are included in the annual commercial registry renewal.

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
